programs.programName: Home and Community-Based Services (HCBS) Waivers in Colorado

verified.notes: Colorado’s senior HCBS pathway is the Elderly, Blind and Disabled (EBD) Waiver; the adult waiver comparison chart lists age 55+ generally, but the waiver factsheet and issue brief indicate the senior-specific threshold is age 65+ for EBD. Income limits are shown on the comparison chart as 300% SSI. Assets shown are countable resources, not home equity or other excluded items.
